'''Sutloo's Trading Post''' was a small store about 3 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] outside of [[Storrd Township]]. It was run by an old settler named [[Sutloo]].

It was built of wood and was constructed in a large blue tree above the jungle floor. A large circuitous staircase wound around the tree and led to a large porch with chair and tables. The ground around the base of the tree was cleared to provide landing spaces for [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] or [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]].

It stocked basic survival gear, and was mostly used by settlers or smugglers who had camps in the jungle and didn't want to make a high profile visit into town for supplies.

[[Tern Ashandrik]] had an account setup at the store by [[Shesstellek]] and would frequently send [[Gorrul Wyke]] there for supplies.
